what: The Hero is covered with no gaps by hand-drawn chunk pieces — when the cover lifts at .8s, the center mark (logo) and darkness fade out over 1s and the background at .5s, then after .2s the pieces each move to their outer positions over 2s (0.42,0,0.58,1) and remain as a border around the video. Once all pieces settle, the header and copy turn on over 1.2s and fx:done fires

options.dur: Distance the pieces are pushed away, default 2 (can be changed per piece with data-dur)
options.delay: Delay before the pieces start after the cover lifts, default .2 (data-delay per piece)
options.rise: Duration (s) of what lights up at the end (rise), default 1.2
options.wait: Wait before start (s), default 0 — attach it after the video or image has loaded and it behaves like the original
options.narrow: Narrow screen condition, default (max-width: 1023px) — data-from-sp and data-to-sp are checked first then
options.[data-fx-part=cover]·[data-fx-part=mark]: Top cover · center mark · dark · background · what lights up at the end (all optional)

use:
Logo

note: Because this part makes people wait, dur · delay · lift · rise are opened up as options. The original started once it had received both the video and the piece images, or after 3 seconds. The consumer matches that wait with wait or late attaching.
